name: elagoht/deploy
description: A collage plugin that turns a static build's captured headers and redirects into the configuration files a static host reads.
setup: Name the static host in plugins-config.json — `"target": "netlify"` (or `cloudflare`, `vercel`, `github-pages`) — or in Go, `deploy.New(deploy.Options{Target: deploy.TargetNetlify})`. Without a target an export warns and writes nothing for a host.

config.description: A collage plugin that turns a static build's captured headers and redirects into the configuration files a static host reads.

target.description: Target is the host to write for: "netlify", "cloudflare", "vercel" or "github-pages". Empty writes nothing.
